title: A Day With Nothing Wrong
objective: Plan her a day around something she enjoys for its own sake, with nothing in it to fix.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna is standing with both hands in her apron pockets. Every pocket is empty.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “I’ve been given a day off. By force.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Pim took my twine. Dorrance took my notebook. He’s reading it right now. I can feel it.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Pim skids up beside you, out of breath.

intro.speaker: PIM
intro.text: “Miss Senna! Doctor Dorrance says if you come back early, he’ll treat everyone himself! He’s got the leech jar out!”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “He would, too. He’s been waiting years for this.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Pim runs off again, holding her bag of boiled sweets over his head like a trophy.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Nobody has so much as a splinter. I asked around.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “What do people do with a day that has nothing wrong in it?”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “So what do you like? Not for work. Just because.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Mushrooms. Finding where they’ve come up. Looking at them without picking any.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Pastries, too. But I can’t eat one without inspecting it, so that’s work again.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She takes her hands out of her empty pockets, then can’t seem to decide where to put them.

options.labelText: “Why not sort the jars? No patients, nobody rushing you. Just you and the labels.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “The jars. I’ve been meaning to redo the jars for weeks.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She spends her day off sorting them by name, then by how ill each could make you, then by name again.

branch.speaker: PIM
branch.text: “Miss Senna! You’re not supposed to be here!”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She seems happy. She also looks exactly the way she does every other day.

options.labelText: “Mushroom walk. Slow, no picking. Then pastries, and I’ll do the inspecting.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “A walk. With no patient at the end of it.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You walk slowly and look down a lot. Mushrooms turn out to be everywhere, once someone points.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She keeps her gloved hands clasped behind her back, so they can’t pick anything.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “*Amanita.* Gorgeous. Don’t touch it. Don’t even breathe on it rudely.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “That’s a puffball. A raindrop hits it and it sighs out a tiny cloud. Completely harmless. Shameless show-off.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Afterward you buy two pastries. You hand her one and tell her you’ve already inspected it. Personally.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She inspects it again anyway. You let her. She hums through most of it.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Nothing went wrong all day. I kept checking.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Same again next time they confiscate my pockets.”

options.labelText: “So you’re no fun unless someone’s ill. Good to know.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Someone’s always ill. I’ll go and find them.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She leaves to find someone with a splinter. It doesn’t take her long.
